text:
maya: Heads up — multiple customers reporting 502/504 on hosted API /v1/generate since ~13:20 UTC, ramped up over ~10m. Affects short and streaming calls. sample trace ids: trace=cd3f1a2b, trace=cd3f1a2c. Auth/billing look clean from our side. Anyone seeing edge LB errors?

dan: yep seeing a spike in Envoy 502 responses on frontdoor cluster (fd-west-1). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/edge/502-spike (spike aligns w/ 13:20). Upstream shows `RST_STREAM`/`ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM`-ish connection resets.

liam: digging into runtime side — logs show a lot of `stream reset by peer` from midproxy pool. Could be keepalive pool exhaustion + slow clients for streaming. Can you paste a curl that reproduces?

maya: repro curl from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4x-mini","input":"large prompt...","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They said streams sometimes hang then 502. Not all tenants impacted — higher rate for embedding/long streams.

dan: quick checks: 1) midproxy connection pool metrics show 100% used for fd-west-1, 2) ephemeral upstream errors (503/504) during same window, 3) no recent frontline deploys at 13:15-13:25 per deploy-bot.

liam: probable root: keepalive slots exhausted by long-lived streaming connections -> Envoy gives 502 while client attempts new stream and upstream resets. Short-term mitigation: reduce idle keepalive timeout on frontdoor, or drain stale conns, or route affected tenants to burst-capable dedicated pool.

julie: customer comms: two mid-market customers impacted, high QPS embedding pipelines. Need a workaround to share asap. Suggest: 1) recommend client backoff + connection reuse, 2) enable tenant fallback to dedicated in console (if they have it) — prod change note?

maya: trying immediate repro with small script that opens 50 concurrent streaming requests to mimic embeddings pipeline. Will post results.

ops-bot: alert: fd-west-1 frontdoor connection_pool_utilization > 90% for 3m. Incident channel created: #inc-1767899999-frontdoor-conn-exhaust.

liam: if maya's repro matches, I'll run a rolling restart of 4 midproxy pods in fd-west-1 to free stuck sockets (non-disruptive plan). Will coordinate with dan for routing.

dan: +1. Also temporarily bump pool size and reduce per-conn timeout by config flag `edge.keepalive.idle_ms` from 300s -> 60s for fd-west-1 to relieve buildup. I can apply a scoped config and watch metric.

maya: quick repro confirmed: sim shows new conn attempts get 502 after pool hits ~1200 active streams. Posting partial logs: `envoy upstream reset: connection failure, reason: connection pool overflow`.

liam: applying rolling restart now (4 nodes). watching `502_rate` and `conn_pool_util`..

(10m later) dan: after restarts + keepalive change, fd-west-1 conn_pool_util down to 40%, 502 rate back to baseline. No deploy required.

julie: customer notify draft: "We've mitigated an edge connection pooling issue causing transient 502/504 for streaming calls. Recommended client backoff and upgrades to avoid long-lived idle streams. We've temporarily changed routing for impacted tenants; we'll follow up with permanent config." OK to send?

maya: send it. Thanks all. Will keep watch for 1h and close if stable. :thumbsup:

liam: added follow-up tasks: 1) add automated pool-threshold alert >80% sustained, 2) improve docs for streaming best practices and sample client backoff, 3) evaluate sticky routing to dedicated pool per tenant.

dan: adding postmortem skeleton to #postmortems and tagging eng-runtime.

maya: closing thread once stable. user-facing support tickets updated with workaround + ETA.
